name: Stalwart
description: Gain +2 HP per level, but no bonus to willpower from character level.

name: Deft
description: Gain a 1d4 bonus to spell saving throws.

name: Eager
description: Gain +1 willpower after slaying an enemy.

name: Prodigy
description: Training skill proficiency levels to expertise or mastery costs 1 fewer training slots.

name: Jack of All Trades
description: Remediation and proficiency skill training require one fewer training slot, but other training is increased by 1.

name: Specialist
description: Choose an attribute. All skill trainings associated with that attribute cost one less training slot. This feat cannot be taken multiple times, and is mutually exclusive with "Jack of all Trades" and "Prodigy".

name: Hot Tempered
description: When you take 5 or more damage in a single blow, gain 1 willpower.

name: Warthog
description: When you fail a saving throw by 1, you can expend 1 willpower to succeed it instead.

name: Early Riser
description: You have advantage on your first skill check of the day.

name: Night Owl
description: You have advantage on skill checks between midnight and sunrise.

name: Flagellant
description: When you take 10 or more damage in a single blow, gain 1 willpower.

name: Take Backsies
description: Once a day, you can expend willpower to reroll a skill check you have failed. The amount of willpower required is equal to the amount by which you failed the roll.

name: Arcane Apprentice
description: You can learn common spells from a chosen school of magic. You can take this feat multiple times, once for each school of magic, but the training slot cost increases by 3 each time.

name: Fast Learner
description: Whenever you learn a new spell, you can attempt a {{skills.sorcery}} check to reduce the training slot cost by 1. The difficulty of the check is 12 plus the spell's level.

name: Sixth Sense
description: When sneaking, you have advantage on {{skills.perception}} checks to see if you have been detected.

name: Mana Regeneration
description: When you begin a combat turn with no willpower, gain one willpower.

name: Steady Hands
description: You can expend 1 willpower to reroll a concentration saving throw (unless triggered by {{damage.lightning}} damage).

name: War Mage
description: You can cast offensive spells with a range of touch as an opportunity attack.

name: March
description: When you cast a spell, gain 6 feet of movement speed.

name: Arcane Adept
description: You can learn academic spells from a chosen school of magic.

name: Well Rounded
description: Your instinct and charisma modifier scores are added together when calculating willpower.

name: Impetuous
description: Your willpower is increased by 3.

name: Savant
description: Your HP is reduced by half, but you gain twice as much willpower from character level.

name: War Criminal Mage
description: You can now learn forbidden spells.

name: Erudite
description: Ingratiated with collegiate fellows, academic spells cost 1 less training slot.

name: Barrage
description: Whenever you cast two or more spells in one turn, gain 1 willpower.

name: Sneakspell
description: Spells you cast are totally quiet to others.

name: Arcane Master
description: You can learn esoteric spells (except from the school of Shamanism).

name: First Strike
description: As long as you're not surprised, you can attempt a difficulty 15 {{skills.initiative}} check. If successful, you can cast a spell before initiative is rolled.

name: Master of Ceremonies
description: Ceremonies cost half as much willpower to cast.

name: Parry
description: You may attempt to parry melee attacks using a reaction. When parrying, your BC is increased by the parry stat of the weapon.

name: Parkour
description: Gain a 1d4 bonus to {{skills.mobility}} checks when climbing.

name: Leapfrog
description: When you jump, you can jump 1 foot higher and six feet farther.

name: Fast Walker
description: When you take the move action, you can move six feet farther.

name: Pensive
description: +1 to saving throws, but -1 to skill checks. +1 {{skills.defense}}

name: Sensitive
description: +1 to skill checks, but -1 to saving throws. +1 {{skills.perception}}

name: Jolly
description: Gain +1 on all skill checks as long as your willpower is full.

name: Billy Goat
description: You gain a 1d4 bonus when making {{skills.mobility}} saving throws.

name: Deep Breath
description: You can hold your breath twice as long as normal.

name: Pratfaller
description: Fall damage is reduced by 2d6.

name: Vertical Escape
description: You may use the grappling hook to make a hasty escape as a combat action. If surroundings are appropriate, you can attempt a difficulty 12 {{skills.mobility}} check to throw the hook up to 30 feet vertically. If it latches, you can use an action to climb 10 feet up the rope, away from enemy melee attacks.

name: Dodge Roll
description: When you take the dodge action, you gain 6 feet of movement speed.

name: Freestyler
description: Swim speed is increased by 6 feet per turn.

name: Blitzkrieg
description: You can make {{skills.martial_arts}} checks using your speed modifier (instead of strength or dexterity)

name: Triage
description: When you take the help action, allies heal twice as much hp.

name: Charlatan
description: You can use charisma as a base attribute for {{skills.sorcery}} checks.

name: Loremaster
description: You can make recognition rolls using the {{skills.folklore}} skill, instead of {{skills.survival}}.

name: Cleaving Strike
description: When making a melee attack with a heavy weapon that deals {{damage.slashing}} damage (but not a polearm), you can expend 2 willpower to strike an additional foe if more than one foe is in range.

name: Shield Bash
description: You can make a bludgeoning attack when carrying a {{weapons.buckler}} or {{weapons.shield}} in your offhand.

name: Shield Charge
description: When you take the jog action while carrying a shield, you can make a 1d8 {{damage.bludgeoning}} damage to an enemy. Dealing damage to any enemy in this way consumes your remaining movement points.

name: Haft Strike
description: When you make a melee attack with a polearm, you can expend 1 willpower to follow it up with a haft strike. The haft strike deals a flat 1d4 {{damage.bludgeoning}} damage and does not benefit from any attribute modifier or the extended reach of the polearm.

name: Dual Wielder
description: When you make a melee weapon attack while dual wielding, you can make a secondary attack with your offhand weapon. The second attack does not benefit from any attribute modifier but is otherwise an ordinary weapon attack.

name: Stop, Drop, and Roll
description: You can expend 2 actions to extinguish all accumulated {{status.burning}}.

name: Riposte
description: You may expend 1 willpower to follow up a successful parry with a counterattack.

name: Momentum
description: Gain 6 feet of movement speed every time you kill an opponent.

name: Friend in Need
description: You can take the "move" and "help" actions in two actions (instead of three).

name: Spellsword
description: When you make a weapon attack on an enemy, it has disadvantage on spell saving throws against your spells until the start of its next turn. When you make a spell attack on an enemy, you have advantage on weapon attacks against it until the start of your next turn.

name: Bookworm
description: You can make recognition rolls using the {{skills.literacy}} skill, instead of {{skills.survival}}

name: Dungeoneer
description: Gain a 1d4 bonus to {{skills.perception}} when exploring dungeons, and to {{skills.legerdemain}} when disarming traps.

name: Prankster
description: You have advantage on rolls to convince your marks that your shenanigans (pickpocketing, lockpicking, deceptions, etc) are harmless pranks.

name: Exceptional
description: Gain +1 willpower whenever you deal a critical hit.

name: Guardian
description: When you take the block action, allies adjacent to you also benefit from the increased BC.

name: That Dog
description: Whenever you take damage that would knock you unconscious, you can expend willpower to remain   conscious (at 1 hp). The willpower required is equal to the excess damage.

name: Come Hither
description: Using an action, the player may throw the grappling hook at a target within 20 feet. Upon a successful {{skills.accuracy}} check against the target’s {{keywords.mit}}, the target is pulled up to 15 feet towards the player.

name: Marathon
description: Jogging costs only one action.

name: Moving Target
description: You can move and dodge as a combined single action.

name: Medic
description: Whenever you take a breather, you can attempt a {{skills.medicine}} check to heal a party member to full health. The difficulty of the check is equal to their missing health.

name: Stoic
description: Whenever you take a breather, regain all your willpower.

name: Party Animal
description: Whenever you take a breather, you and everyone in your party regains an additional 1d4 willpower.

name: Blunt Cleave
description: You can use the cleaving strike maneuver with weapons that deal {{damage.bludgeoning}} damage.

name: Skull-Crusher
description: When making a heavy attack, the damage dice are added together instead of taking the maximum value.

name: Charge Through
description: When performing a shield charge, you can damage an additional enemy.

name: Wall Jump
description: When you take the jump action next to a wall, your jump distance is doubled.

name: Adrenaline Rush
description: Gain +1 temporary willpower at the start of battle.

name: Surge
description: You can expend 4 willpower to gain an action, once per turn.

name: Walking Mountain
description: Your armor BC is added to your maximum willpower.

name: Double Dog
description: The willpower required to stay conscious (via the {{feats.that_dog}} feat) is reduced by one half (but cannot be reduced below 1).

name: Fleetfooted
description: Your first move action each turn no longer costs an action.

name: Titan
description: Gain +1 willpower when an attack is blocked by your armor.

name: Steel Avalanche
description: You can expend 2 willpower to add your armor BC to a two-handed melee weapon attack.

name: Dog Gone
description: The willpower required to stay conscious (via the {{feats.that_dog}} feat) is reduced by one quarter instead of one half (but cannot be reduced below 1).

name: Bloodthirsty
description: When you get a kill during a rage, you can expend 1 willpower to increase your rage level by 1.

name: Perseverance
description: Your rage sustains you in your darkest hour. Once per turn, when you take damage while below half hp, your rage level increases by 1.

name: Anger Management
description: The cost to rage is decreased from 3 to 2.

name: Thunderin' Tarnation
description: magic is stupid, but you can make it go away by yelling at it. Enemies which fail their saving throw against your roar may not cast spells on their next turn, and lose concentration on any spells they have already cast.

name: Armor of God
description: Add half your armor BC when making saving throws against spells.

name: Immortal
description: Your armor BC is added to your

name: Praetorian
description: You no longer have disadvantage to {{skills.mobility}} checks while wearing armor.

name: Samurai
description: The penalty to maximum DC when wearing heavy armor is reduced by 2.

name: Templar
description: Ignore disadvantage on stealth checks while wearing full plate.

name: Crazy Eights
description: Whenever you roll an 8 on a d20, something unexpected happens. It is what it is.

name: Lucky Sevens
description: When you roll a seven on a d20, it counts as a critical.
